svg.title: Nail knot — how to tie it
svg.desc: Nail knot, in 5 steps. Lay a small tube alongside the fly line tip and the leader butt. Wrap the leader butt around line and tube six or seven turns, working toward the line tip. Feed the tag back through the tube and withdraw the tube. Pull the wraps snug a little at a time, alternating ends. Seat hard, trim both tags, and coat if you want it to shoot cleanly.
